title: Flexsteel Industries, Inc. Reports Strong Fiscal First Quarter 2026 Results
summary: DUBUQUE, Iowa --(BUSINESS WIRE)--Oct. 20, 2025-- Flexsteel Industries, Inc. (NASDAQ: FLXS) (“Flexsteel” or the “Company”), one of the largest manufacturers, importers, and marketers of residential furniture products in the United States , today reported first quarter fiscal 2026 results.
body_text: PDF Version DUBUQUE, Iowa--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Oct. 20, 2025-- Flexsteel Industries, Inc. (NASDAQ: FLXS) (“Flexsteel” or the “Company”), one of the largest manufacturers, importers, and marketers of residential furniture products in the United States, today reported first quarter fiscal 2026 results. Key Results for the First Quarter Ended September 30, 2025 Net sales for the quarter of $110.4 million compared to $104.0 million in the prior year quarter, an increase of 6.2%. GAAP operating income of $9.0 million or 8.1% of net sales for the first quarter compared to $6.0 million or 5.8% of net sales in the prior year quarter. GAAP net income per diluted share of $1.31 for the current quarter compared to net income per diluted share of $0.74 in the prior year quarter. GAAP to non-GAAP reconciliations follow the financial statements in this press release Management Commentary “We delivered strong results in the quarter, and I’m pleased with our continued growth momentum and margin expansion,” said Derek Schmidt, CEO of Flexsteel Industries, Inc. “Despite choppy consumer demand and a challenging macroeconomic environment, the strength of our product offerings and continued investments in innovation and marketing are propelling our consistent growth and enabled a 6.2% sales increase in the quarter, which represents our eighth consecutive quarter of year-over-year growth. Our multi-pronged growth strategy is working well as we realized growth in the quarter from both our core market initiatives, driven largely by new products, and our new/expanded market efforts where we are ramping sales in both the casegoods and health and wellness product categories. Our revenue growth coupled with disciplined product portfolio management and operational cost savings are leading our continued margin expansion as we delivered a strong operating margin of 8.1% in the quarter, which represents our tenth consecutive quarter of year-over-year improvement and a 230 basis point increase compared to the prior year.” Mr. Schmidt continues, “While we are executing well in a difficult environment, and I remain optimistic about the fundamental drivers of long-term industry growth, we continue to face significant risks and headwinds in the near term. Many of our retail partners noted that consumer traffic and sales were especially uneven during the recent quarter, suggesting that consumer confidence remains fragile given growing concerns about inflation and employment growth. Additionally, tariffs persist as a major risk to both demand and margins. While we gained additional clarity on reciprocal tariff changes in August, and we subsequently took action to mitigate the adverse impact of those tariffs, on September 29th the White House issued a proclamation establishing section 232 tariffs on imported timber, lumber, and their derivative products, including upholstered furniture. The new section 232 tariffs superseded the prior reciprocal tariffs and put a 25% tariff on imported upholstered furniture effective October 14th, which will subsequently increase to 30% effective January 1, 2026. We anticipate the tariff change to result in broad price increases for furniture and be highly disruptive to both consumer demand and industry margins in the short term. As we’ve demonstrated in the past, our company is agile and ready to respond to major shifts in market dynamics while remaining steadfast in our execution of our growth strategies and key investments to continue gaining market share.” Mr. Schmidt concludes, “While tariff changes are projected to have a material impact on our sales and profitability short-term, our company is financially strong and well-positioned to navigate these near-term challenges while continuing to strengthen our competitiveness and drive long-term profitable growth and shareholder value." Operating Results for the First Quarter Ended September 30, 2025 Net sales were $110.4 million for the first quarter compared to net sales of $104.0 million in the prior year quarter, an increase of $6.4 million, or 6.2%. The increase was driven by our sourced soft seating products, partially offset by lower unit volume in our made-to-order soft seating products and homestyles branded ready-to-assemble category. Gross margin for the quarter ended September 30, 2025, was 23.5%, compared to 21.5% for the prior-year quarter, an increase of 200 basis points (“bps”). The 200-bps increase was primarily driven by sales leverage, and favorable foreign currency translation of our peso denominated assets in Mexico in the current quarter versus unfavorable foreign currency translation the prior year quarter. Selling, general and administrative (SG&A) expenses decreased to 15.4% of net sales in the first quarter of fiscal 2026 compared with 15.7% of net sales in the prior year quarter. The decrease was mainly due to leverage on higher sales, partially offset by investments in growth initiatives. Operating income for the quarter ended September 30, 2025, was $9.0 million compared to $6.0 million in the prior year quarter. The Company reported income tax expense of $2.1 million, or an effective rate of 21.9%, during the first quarter compared to tax expense of $1.9 million, or an effective rate of 31.0%, in the prior year quarter. The Company reported net income of $7.3 million, or $1.31 per diluted share, for the quarter ended September 30, 2025, compared to net income of $4.1 million, or $0.74 per diluted share, in the prior year quarter. Liquidity The Company ended the quarter with a cash balance of $38.6 million, and working capital (current assets less current liabilities) of $116.9 million, and availability of approximately $54.1 million under its secured line of credit. Capital expenditures for the quarter ended September 30, 2025, were $1.4 million. About Flexsteel Flexsteel Industries, Inc., and Subsidiaries (the “Company”) is one of the largest manufacturers, importers, and marketers of residential furniture products in the United States. Product offerings include a wide variety of furniture such as sofas, loveseats, chairs, reclining rocking chairs, swivel rockers, sofa beds, convertible bedding units, occasional tables, desks, dining tables and chairs, kitchen storage, bedroom furniture, and outdoor furniture. A featured component in most of the upholstered furniture is a unique steel drop-in seat spring from which the name “Flexsteel” is derived. The Company distributes its products throughout the United States through its e-commerce channel and direct sales force. title: IMF Messages: An Apparent Calm in a More Fragile World
summary: The International Monetary Fund (IMF) released its October 2025 World Economic Outlook and Global Financial Stability Report, drawing a picture of a global economy that appears stable on the surface yet remains fragile underneath. The reports warn that growth is slowing, trade is fragmenting, and financial vulnerabilities are deepening. While global markets show an outward calm, the Fund stresses that the balance of risks remains tilted to the downside, shaped by high debt, uneven policy alignment, and persistent uncertainty. The IMF calls on policymakers to rebuild buffers and reinforce resilience to withstand future shocks.
body_text: IMF Messages: An Apparent Calm in a More Fragile World The International Monetary Fund (IMF) released its October 2025 World Economic Outlook and Global Financial Stability Report, drawing a picture of a global economy that appears stable on the surface yet remains fragile underneath. The reports warn that growth is slowing, trade is fragmenting, and financial vulnerabilities are deepening. While global markets show an outward calm, the Fund stresses that the balance of risks remains tilted to the downside, shaped by high debt, uneven policy alignment, and persistent uncertainty. The IMF calls on policymakers to rebuild buffers and reinforce resilience to withstand future shocks. Key messages from both reports: Subdued and uneven growth across countries. Global GDP is projected to expand by 3.2 percent in 2025 and 3.1 percent in 2026, compared with 3.3 percent in 2024, reflecting slower trade, rising protectionism, and weak productivity. While downside risks persist, upside potential hinges on international cooperation and productivity gains driven by artificial intelligence. A reduction in global uncertainty or faster AI-led productivity growth could raise world output by 0.3–0.4 percentage points in the near term. Trade tensions. The U.S. tariff increases introduced in 2025 have slowed global trade and reshaped supply chains; the IMF estimates a cumulative global output loss of 0.2 percent through 2026. Diverging inflation paths. Global inflation is expected to decline to 4.2 percent in 2025 and 3.7 percent in 2026, though it will remain above target in the United States. Tariff pass-through to consumer prices remains a key risk. Misaligned policy mix. Fiscal policy remains expansionary in most major economies, while monetary stances diverge. In the United States, fiscal expansion raises concerns about debt sustainability, while fiscal policy in Europe is also loosening. Echoes of the tech bubble. The current wave of AI-related investment recalls the exuberance of the late-1990s internet era, with stretched valuations and the risk of a sharp correction if profit expectations prove unfounded. Paradoxically, AI could also become a source of stronger global productivity. Apparent calm, rising vulnerabilities. Financial markets appear stable, but high debt levels, stretched valuations, and the growing role of nonbank financial intermediaries (NBFIs) are heightening systemic risk. Stretched valuations and sovereign debt concerns. Asset prices remain elevated despite slower growth, while widening fiscal deficits are pushing up term premia and tightening the sovereign–bank nexus. Banks are stronger, but still exposed. Global stress tests show higher capital ratios than in 2023. The global CET1 capital ratio (a key solvency indicator) would fall moderately from 13.0 percent in 2024 to 12.3 percent under the adverse scenario. The IMF devotes special attention to the interconnections and contagion channels between banks and NBFIs. Expansion of stablecoins and tokenized assets. Their rapid growth could reshape money markets and monetary-policy transmission, especially in more vulnerable economies exposed to currency substitution and forced asset sales during periods of stress. Key recommendations. The IMF calls for strengthening fiscal buffers and policy credibility, ensuring sustainable fiscal consolidation and preserving central-bank independence. It urges the full implementation of Basel III to reinforce bank capital and liquidity and broaden the macroprudential perimeter to address emerging risks from NBFIs and digital assets. Structurally, the IMF advocates reviving predictable, rules-based trade, aligning industrial policy with productivity rather than protectionism, and enhancing multilateral cooperation to reduce fragmentation and bolster global resilience.

title: PC Gaming Controllers: Why Rotating Modules Change Everything
summary: How rotating modules in PC gaming controllers revolutionize gameplay. Explore Turtle Beach's innovative modular designs for FPS, racing & fighting games.
body_text: Gaming performance depends on having the right tools that adapt to your playstyle. Just like tournament preparation requires optimal equipment, choosing the best PC gaming controllers can make or break your performance across different genres. While traditional controllers lock you into one layout, modular gaming controllers with rotating joysticks are revolutionizing gaming. Modern gamers demand versatility that matches their diverse gaming libraries. Whether you need the precision of dedicated gaming headsets for audio positioning or the responsiveness of advanced gaming keyboards for competitive play, your controller should offer the same adaptability. The Turtle Beach controller collection addresses this need with innovative rotating module technology. What Are Rotating Modules in PC Gaming Controllers? Rotating modules represent a breakthrough in controller design, allowing gamers to physically rotate sections of their controller to switch between different button layouts optimized for specific game genres. Unlike traditional controllers that force you to adapt to a single configuration, rotating control modules give you the versatility to quickly and easily switch from a traditional button and thumbstick layout to one designed for domination on fighter games. The technology works through mechanical modules that can be unlocked and rotated to reveal different control surfaces. These rotate between a standard asymmetrical Xbox-esque layout and a six-button lineup, shifting the D-pad into a more accessible position for your thumb. This innovation addresses a fundamental challenge in PC gaming: different genres demand different control schemes for optimal performance. Turtle Beach's groundbreaking Stealth Pivot controller exemplifies this revolutionary approach. The Stealth Pivot's rotating button and stick modules quickly switch between core button layouts, including FPS, action, and racing games on one side, and revolved layouts for fighting and retro games on the other side. How Rotating Modules Enhance Gaming Precision Gaming precision has evolved beyond simple button presses. Hall Effect Sensors convert magnetic field changes into precise electrical signals, replacing potentiometer parts in a controller, and when combined with rotating modules, they create unmatched precision gaming experiences. The elimination of the dead zone in Hall Effect controllers translates into enhanced precision and responsiveness, making them ideal for FPS multiplayer games. The Stealth Pivot incorporates AntiDrift thumbsticks that use internal magnets instead of full-contact analog-style sticks to provide high-resolution, smooth control without drift. Since the magnet never touches the hall element, mechanical drift is impossible and wear is nonexistent in these modules. Gamers enjoy precise, fluid control during continuous gameplay. This contactless technology ensures tournament-level precision throughout the controller's lifespan. The Impact of Modular Design on Customization Customization isn't just about aesthetics - it's about performance optimization. The Stealth Pivot features two rotating modules that are integrated directly into the gamepad. The right module features a standard thumbstick and four face buttons on one side and a six-button fight pad on the other. Advanced gaming controller design, like the Stealth Pivot, offers extensive customization beyond rotating modules. Four mappable buttons and up to five onboard profiles allow precise setup for different game types. The mapping button enables quick adjustments for vibration intensity, dead zones, and button remapping. For gamers demanding granular control, this represents a significant leap forward from traditional controllers. Adjustable triggers modify trigger throw distance for faster FPS response or precise racing control. This adaptability means a single controller excels across multiple genres without compromise. Benefits of Rotating Modules for Different Game Genres Each game genre has unique control requirements, and rotating modules address these needs systematically: Fighting Games : The modules rotate to produce a D-pad and button layout suitable for fighting games. The six-button layout mimics arcade-style fighting controls, enabling complex combo execution. First-Person Shooters : The standard layout optimizes thumbstick placement for precision aiming. With a 0 dead zone, players can perform quick and accurate movements for precise aiming and rapid response. Racing Games : Full trigger travel provides complete throttle and brake control. The analog triggers offer nuanced control for professional-level racing simulation. Action and Adventure : The versatile standard layout accommodates complex control schemes while customization allows optimization for specific mechanics. This genre-specific optimization represents a paradigm shift in controller design. Just as professional gamers use different headsets for different audio needs, rotating modules allows the same flexibility in control schemes. Comparing Traditional Controllers vs. Rotating Module Controllers Traditional controllers force compromises. You either choose Xbox-style offset sticks or PlayStation-style symmetrical layouts, and you're locked into that decision. Rotating module controllers like the Stealth Pivot break these limitations entirely by physically transforming their layout. Durability : Contactless input extends device lifespan while boosting accuracy. Traditional analog sticks wear out through physical contact, while Hall Effect sensors in rotating module controllers maintain precision indefinitely. Precision : Hall effect sensors are more durable and have a longer lifespan than potentiometer-based joysticks, and they are also more accurate and precise. This advantage becomes more pronounced over time as traditional controllers develop drift issues. Versatility : Traditional controllers excel at one layout. Rotating module controllers excel at multiple layouts, making them more cost-effective for gamers who play diverse genres. The Victrix Pro BFG Reloaded represents Turtle Beach's commitment to modular excellence with swappable components, while the Stealth Pivot pushes boundaries further with integrated rotating systems. Future Trends in PC Gaming Controller Technology TMR technology represents the next evolution beyond the Hall Effect, offering higher sensitivity for detecting smaller stick movements. Future controllers will integrate seamlessly with complete gaming ecosystems, as demonstrated by Turtle Beach's approach with advanced customization for adaptive gaming needs. How to Choose a PC Controller with Rotating Modules Selecting the right controller requires considering several factors: Primary Game Genres : If you primarily play fighting games, prioritize controllers with robust six-button layouts. FPS enthusiasts should focus on trigger customization and thumbstick precision. Racing fans need analog trigger sensitivity. Build Quality : Moving parts require proven durability records and solid construction materials for long-term reliability. Software Support : The Control Center 2 app adjusts controller settings like button mapping, dead zones, vibration intensity, audio enhancements, and RGB lighting. Connectivity Options : Gamers can play wirelessly and lag-free on PC using the 2.4GHz wireless transmitter, as well as in wired mode for PC and Xbox consoles. Ensure compatibility with your gaming setup. Ecosystem Compatibility : The Stealth Pivot works seamlessly with Turtle Beach's audio ecosystem, enhancing your overall gaming experience. For different gaming needs, consider the Stealth Ultra Controller for maximum customization, while the Victrix Pro BFG Reloaded excels in competitive gaming with its modular swappable components. Conclusion Rotating modules represent the future of PC gaming controllers, offering unprecedented versatility without sacrificing precision. The Stealth Pivot's rotating modules, premium build quality, and deep customization demonstrate Turtle Beach's innovation leadership in gaming accessories. As gaming evolves toward genre specialization and competitive precision, having adaptable equipment becomes crucial. Whether perfecting combos in fighting games, achieving headshots in FPS titles, or dominating racing circuits, rotating module controllers like the Stealth Pivot ensure you're never compromising on control. Ready to experience the revolution? Explore the complete Turtle Beach controller collection and discover how rotating modules can transform your gaming performance across every genre you love. Frequently Asked Questions What is a rotating module in a gaming controller? A rotating module is a physical section of the controller that can be unlocked and rotated to reveal different button and control layouts optimized for specific game genres, eliminating the need for multiple controllers. How do rotating modules improve gameplay on PC? Rotating modules allow instant optimization for different game types - from six-button fighting layouts to precision FPS configurations - while maintaining Hall Effect sensor precision that eliminates stick drift and enhances accuracy. This versatility complements other Turtle Beach gaming accessories for a complete competitive setup. Are modular controllers better than standard controllers? Modular controllers offer superior versatility, durability through Hall Effect technology, and genre-specific optimization that standard controllers cannot match, making them ideal for gamers who play multiple game types. Which games benefit most from rotating joystick controllers? Fighting games see the biggest advantage from six-button layouts, while FPS titles benefit from precision thumbstick placement and trigger customization. Racing games gain from analog trigger sensitivity, and retro games enjoy authentic classic layouts. Can rotating modules be added to any gaming controller? Rotating modules require specific engineering integration and cannot be retrofitted to existing controllers. They must be built into the controller's design from the ground up, like in the Turtle Beach Stealth Pivot. What are the top PC controllers with rotating modules? The Turtle Beach Stealth Pivot leads the market with integrated rotating modules, Hall Effect sensors, and comprehensive customization. The Stealth Ultra offers advanced display integration, while the Victrix Pro BFG Reloaded provides modular swappable components for different gaming needs.

title: Introducing support for Renters Insurance
summary: Axle has expanded its insurance data platform to include renters insurance. This update enables partners to instantly verify renters policies in real time — improving compliance, reducing manual work, and enhancing the tenant onboarding experience.
body_text: At Axle, we’re building the infrastructure to power real-time access to insurance data across every line of coverage. Today, we're excited to announce that Axle now supports renters (HO-4) insurance . With this launch, partners can now verify renters insurance policies alongside auto, home, and flood — helping streamline operations, improve compliance, and enhance the end-user experience. Why Renters Insurance? Renters insurance is a standard requirement in residential leasing and property management, but verifying coverage has historically been slow, manual, and unreliable. Property managers and landlords often depend on tenant-provided PDFs or declarations pages — with no way to confirm the policy is active or meets requirements. By extending support to renters insurance, Axle helps solve that gap, bringing speed, accuracy, and automation to a historically offline process. Benefits for Our Partners With renters insurance now supported, partners can leverage the same Axle capabilities they already use across other lines of insurance — including Verification, Monitoring, Validation Engine, and DocAI — all built on a universal policy spec that ensures consistency and scalability. This means you get a single, unified framework for accessing and managing policy data, no matter the coverage type — renters, auto, home, or flood. Key benefits include: Instant policy verification via real-time carrier connections Continuous monitoring for policy changes and ongoing compliance Automated compliance check (via Axle's Validation Engine) Document intelligence with DocAI for faster, more accurate document parsing Less manual review and improved operational efficiency Streamlined onboarding and an enhanced end-user experience Flexible input methods , including insurer login and document upload Whether you’re managing properties, building tenant screening workflows, or embedding insurance into rental platforms, Axle brings the same speed, reliability, and automation you expect — now extended to renters insurance. Get Started with Renters Insurance on Axle This is just the beginning. We’re expanding our carrier network to support broader renters insurance coverage in the coming months. Reach out to our team to get started. ‍

title: UNIFI®, Makers of REPREVE®, Schedules First Quarter Fiscal 2026 Earnings Conference Call
summary: The Investor Relations website contains information about UNIFI, Inc.'s business for stockholders, potential investors, and financial analysts.
body_text: GREENSBORO, N.C.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Oct. 29, 2025-- Unifi, Inc. (NYSE: UFI), (together with its consolidated subsidiaries, “UNIFI”), the makers of REPREVE® and one of the world’s leading innovators in recycled and synthetic yarns, will host a conference call at 8:30 a.m., Eastern Time, on Wednesday, November 5, 2025, to discuss its first quarter fiscal 2026 financial results. The first quarter fiscal 2026 financial results and supporting materials will be available after the close of market trading on Tuesday, November 4, 2025, on the Company’s website at http://investor.unifi.com . The conference call can be accessed approximately 10 minutes prior to the beginning of the call by dialing (800) 715-9871 (Domestic) or (646) 307-1963 (International) and, when prompted, providing conference ID number 7048274. There will also be a live audio webcast of the call, which can be accessed on the Company’s website at http://investor.unifi.com . A replay of the conference call will be available approximately two hours following the call through Wednesday, November 12, 2025, and can be accessed via the Company’s website at http://investor.unifi.com . In addition, presentation slides will be available on the Company’s website for 12 months following the call. About UNIFI, Inc. UNIFI, Inc. (NYSE: UFI) is a global leader in fiber science and sustainable synthetic textiles. Using proprietary recycling technology, UNIFI is a pioneer in scaling the transformation of post-industrial and post-consumer waste into sustainable products. Through REPREVE®, the world’s leading brand of traceable, recycled fiber and resin, UNIFI is changing the way industries think about the materials they use – and reuse. A vertically-integrated manufacturer, the company has direct operations in the United States, Colombia, El Salvador, and Brazil, and sales offices all over the world. UNIFI envisions a future where circular and sustainable solutions are the only choice. For more information about UNIFI, visit www.UNIFI.com . About REPREVE® Made by UNIFI, Inc. (NYSE: UFI), REPREVE® is the global leader in recycled performance fibers and resins. Using proprietary recycling technology, REPREVE leverages multiple waste sources, including single-use plastic bottles, ocean-bound plastic, textile waste, and recycled yarn. REPREVE has transformed more than 46 billion plastic bottles and 1 billion T-shirts’ worth of textile waste into recycled fiber, powering globally scalable products for world-leading brands. Made traceable with FiberPrint® technology and certified by U-TRUST®, REPREVE spans apparel, footwear, furnishings, industrial, medical, military, mobility, and packaging. For more information about REPREVE, visit www.repreve.com .
